title: Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic ascending free-group mapping tori
exact_target: For a finitely generated free group F and injective endomorphism $\varphi :F\to F$, if the ascending HNN extension $\langle F,t|t^{-1}ft=\varphi (f)$, $f\in F\rangle $ is word-hyperbolic, must it be virtually compact special?
